start: Gym page of a gym with sign-ins in the last 7 days, support access closed

steps.action: Scroll to 'Sign-in history' and tap 'Show sign-in history'
user_sees: 'Times only. Names, devices and addresses show only while support access is open.'
One row per event with the time and what happened
must_not: A name, device or address column while access is closed

start: Gym page of a gym whose support access is open

user_sees: 'Support access is open, so names, devices and addresses show (the gym owner sees this look).'
Columns Who, Device and From filled in
must_not: Names shown after the access window has ended
The look not shown to the gym owner

start: Gym page of a brand-new gym with no sign-ins

must_not: An empty table with no words

steps.action: Tap it again while the gym server cannot be reached
user_sees: An error line under the button in plain words
must_not: The old list kept as if it were fresh

start: Gym page with support access open, history shown in detail

steps.action: The gym closes support access; tap 'Show sign-in history' again
user_sees: 'Times only. Names, devices and addresses show only while support access is open.'
The Who, Device and From columns gone
must_not: Names, devices or addresses still shown after the close

steps.action: Tap 'Show sign-in history' and read every column
must_not: A staff name, a device or an IP address while access is closed
Rows older than the kept 7 days shown as if kept longer
